title: Matched-control shallow PPO greedy fresh5k Slumbot recovery
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The two-update Standard10-initialized matched control can produce a positive fresh Slumbot point estimate under historical greedy execution, because it is only a shallow update and was +7.13 bb/100 versus Standard10 on untouched internal decks.
material_change: Packaging-only recovery from the zero-hand failed predecessor. Freeze the identical checkpoint and evaluate exactly eight new independent sessions of 625 successful hands; no retries, replacements, training, action overrides, or checkpoint changes.
baseline: Historical Standard10 greedy fresh20k -11.4275 bb/100 CI [-28.7124,5.8574]; predecessor failed at test collection with zero Slumbot hands.
notes: Promotion gate unchanged: bb/100 > 0 and at least 4/8 positive session means. Raw and session CIs diagnostic only. Seeds 2026137101-2026137108 are new and fixed before execution.

result.summary: Admission tests passed, but all eight session processes rejected the v4-observation checkpoint before the first Slumbot request; zero raw hands exist.
result.conclusion: The candidate intentionally uses the audited physical-v6 legacy-v4 observation bridge, while the recovery command omitted --observation-bridge legacy-v4. This is an execution-contract packaging failure, not poker evidence.
result.next_step: Use the already proven legacy-bridge Slumbot orchestration, verify model loading offline before launch, then start a distinct fixed-session recovery with new seeds.
